subject: [PATCH 4/4] selftests/mm: check split results by position, drop gather_folio_orders()

2026-09-29.patch_summary: This patch modifies the split_huge_page_test to check the results of a split by position, rather than just counting folios of each order in the range. It achieves this by checking that each PMD-sized part of the range came out as expected after a non-uniform split. The test also removes its own use of gather_folio_orders() and instead uses cached descriptors directly. This change requires every page to be present, which is acceptable since the test has already read the whole range.
